notes.title: Final Sale & Delisting Info
notes.content:
Hi all,

We wanted to take some time and reply to the latest comments and share some news regarding the delisting date.

[i]Seeking Evil: The Wendigo[/i] was always meant to be a compact, focused game with optional VR support and the goal of delivering a few good scares, tense moments, and some classic horror fun.

While interest was quiet for a long time (read: non-existent), we’ve seen a surprising wave of attention following the delisting announcement.  

This comes as a total surprise to us, so whether you revisited it, picked it up for the first time, or just joined the conversation: [b]thank you[/b]. It means a lot. 

Some games are made to offer a specific experience, and when that’s done, it’s okay to let them rest. Ours, for the most part, did what we hoped and after many years, we’ve decided it’s time to say goodbye the right way.

[color=#f48c06][b]The game will be permanently delisted from Steam on July 21 at 12:45 PM PST.[/b][/color]  
[i]If you own it, it will remain fully accessible in your Steam library, just like before.[/i]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]7 Day Final Sale[/h2]

We received quite a lot of requests about a final sale.
For that reason, we’ve applied a [color=#3ba55c][b]final 7-day discount[/b][/color], starting [b]July 14 at 12:45 PM PST[/b]. The game will be delisted right after that.

80% is the [b]deepest discount we’re able to set in Steam[/b].  
If you purchased the game shortly before the sale and feel caught off guard, you’re welcome to request a refund and repurchase it during the discount window, we completely understand and support this.

[hr][/hr]

[b][i]Thanks again for understanding, for playing, for sharing, and for being part of this journey.[/i][/b]

notes.title: Full release and steam leaderboards
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0WF5Fqj.png[/img]


[h1][b]Fellow evil seekers[/b][/h1]
Today is a big day for us! Seeking Evil - The Wendigo has been officially released on Steam. 

Just in case you haven't heard much about the game, here's a short summary; It's a fast paced horror title that takes place in the haunted forests of North America. These are home to a bloodthirsty predator known as the Wendigo. It's intelligent, fast and will do everything it can to hunt you down, the only way that you'll get out alive is by burning all totems and breaking the curse. 

We'd like to take the chance and thank you, our family, friends and everyone for supporting us so far and making this game possible. A horror game was on our list for a while now so we enjoyed the development process and learned a lot from it. We also had a blast while watching the videos that many of you shared and hope that the game will continue to deliver people scares and thrills in the future.

[h1][b]Leaderboards update[/b][/h1]
As promised in our previous post we'd still like to introduce online leaderboards that allow you to compare your highscore with that of other players. In addition we've also made the following improvements:
[list]
[*]Optimized the game to ensure that it runs better in VR.
[*]Increased the maximum value of the sensitivity setting.
[*]Removed debugging indication for eye gaze value.
[*]Fixed issue with eye gaze sound loop.
[*]Modified observatory flies so that they're easier to avoid; getting the achievement should be easier right now.
[*]Other minor tweaks
[/list]
 
Thank you guys and if there's anything let us know!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/L6EC09A.png[/img]

Copybugpaste Team

notes.title: [UPDATE]Steam trading cards
notes.content:
[h1][b]From the team[/b][/h1]
We're glad to announce that we haven't found any major issues so far and that we're taking the necessary steps towards full release in the near future. That said we're really happy to announce that Steam trading cards have made it into the game.

[h1][b]How does this work[/b][/h1]
Simply put trading cards are collectible cards that you can earn by playing the game. By collecting the entire set of cards you can earn items that will help you to customize your profile and show off gameplay. Here are some details on how this works:
[list]
[*][b]Playing the game:[/b] this will earn you half of the set (based on playtime in the game).
[*][b]Trade:[/b] the other half of the set can be earned through trading or buying from other players on the Steam Community Market.
[*][b]Craft:[/b] once you've got a full set you can craft a badge that can be prominently displayed on the profile and when hovering on your avatar.
[*][b]Get rewarded:[/b] during badge crafting you'll receive random rewards like emoticons and profile backgrounds.

notes.title: [Update] Achievements!
notes.content:
Hi fellow Evil Seekers,

We're happy to announce that today we've released a new update that introduces Steam Achievements. We had a ton of ideas on how to approach this and eventually handpicked a total of 12 as our final choice, below you can see a list of what to expect.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/mJNF35T.jpg[/img]

Since we've been gathering additional feedback and working on a major update for our other game called [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/325420/Homebrew__Vehicle_Sandbox/]Homebrew - Vehicle Sandbox[/url] the update was slightly delayed. We'd like to apologize for this and thank you guys for your patience and support. 

We've also noticed that the game runs well on most pc's and that there haven't been any major bugs. If you run into an issue, make sure to let us know asap so that we can patch this prior to our full release which we'll be announcing soon. 

Make sure to keep an eye out for our upcoming updates that will include steam trading cards, leaderboards and improved controller support as well. 

Cheers!

Copybugpaste team

notes.title: Hotfix!
notes.content:
We're back again with another update!

This update there have been a couple of improvements, including some added colliders to stop people from getting out of the map by accident, and some changes to the trees.

We've also changed the default gamma setting for the Oculus rift a bit (as the game was far too bright) 
Besides these changes, there have been a number of performance tweaks, and Level-of-detail improvements. It should be a bit smoother now 

If you experience any bugs, or issues, let us know

Copybugpaste Team.

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
We're pushing a small update to address some of the problems that some of you have been facing, and make the game a bit easier to play. 

First of all, we've changed the Screen-Effects a bit, and (more specifically) the Gamma. The game will now be less dark, and more enjoyable to play!

We've also fixed a couple of collisions issues, so you can no longer escape the map (Sorry), and it's far easier to get on top of the plank above the pit now. 

There was also a bug where the torch would appear lit after it has gone out, this has now been fixed, and a couple of other tiny things (like the score-counter sound not stopping on some occasions, requiring a reboot). 

The totems will light-up more brightly now when you scan, and the range of the scan has been increased slightly, so it should be a bit easier to find your next target now! The flashlight range has also been increased. 

There's also been some changes on the instructions sliders, it should be more straightforward now that you can use your Ankh to find totems, and that you have to tap F while  holding shift to sprint!

You can also get out of your crouch now by running. Since we've noticed a lot of people were trying to run, and couldn't because they were crouching. 

Thanks to all the players so far, we've been enjoying watching all the videos that have come out from people playing Seeking Evil, and hope to see more soon! 


And please, do not hesitate to report bugs! We'll fix them as soon as we can! 

CopyBugPaste Team.
